ev.q: A total of 1,967 (79%) of 2,488 eligible girls received 3 doses of vaccine
The proportion of school girls vaccinated increased with increasing age
Among these girls, 83% (n = 2,075) received the first dose
The 79% 3-dose vaccination coverage achieved in this project
was higher among girls who attended public school compared with those who attended private school
The objectives were to evaluate HPV vaccine implementation among age-eligible girls

methods_quotes.q: The proportion of school girls vaccinated increased with increasing age (Cochran-Armitage trend test p<0.001)
* Age on date of first vaccination day in school.
